name: @sahelflow/marketing-remotion
description: SahelFlow marketing and product-demonstration videos built with Remotion.

scripts.render:launch: npm run prepare:render && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-Launch-60 renders/sahelflow-launch-60.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --overwrite
scripts.render:social: npm run prepare:render && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-Social-30 renders/sahelflow-social-30.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --overwrite
scripts.render:vertical: npm run prepare:render && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-Vertical-15 renders/sahelflow-vertical-15.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --overwrite
scripts.render:demo: npm run prepare:render && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-Demo-90 renders/sahelflow-demo-90.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --overwrite
scripts.render:preview: npm run render:vertical && npm run render:social
